newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Investment in Russia declines, nonpayments soar.
newsitem.headline: Investment in Russia declines, nonpayments soar.

text.p: Investment in the Russian economy fell eight percent in 1996 and six percent in the first four months of 1997, First Deputy Finance Minister Vladimir Panskov was quoted by Prime-Tass news agency as saying on Tuesday.
He did not say against which period the four-month figure was being compared or specify the sources of investment.
Panskov said nonpayments between industrial enterprises, a major problem crippling the economy, had reached 1,000 trillion roubles ($174 billion).
Russian gross domestic product in the first four months of this year totalled 810 trillion roubles.
